purpose: Source-only visual rubric for the ten-photo vector-reconstruction pilot. Counts are visible camera-space observations and intervals, not ownership certification, facade ground truth, rectification, or material albedo.

visibleWindows.note: Three repeated upper rows show three openings each; the lower-left glazed opening is partly hidden by shrubs and may be counted separately by an output.

visibleDoors.note: One arched double-leaf entrance is plainly visible at lower right.

materialBands: dark brown brick over the principal facade
pale window surrounds and arch trim
dark/red entrance zone at ground level
records.occlusion: Bare shrub growth blocks the lower left; wires cross the middle facade.

visibleWindows.note: Four mostly repeated rows of three tall openings are visible; the left edge is cropped and should not be regularized beyond the photograph.

visibleDoors.note: A deep arched ground-level recess is visible at right, but its door leaf is not reliably resolved.

materialBands: pale ground-floor retail or glazed band
records.occlusion: Strong directional sunlight and a crop through the left neighbor; ground detail is limited.

visibleWindows.note: Three upper rows largely present as three bays, but balcony railings and the lower crop make one central opening ambiguous.

visibleDoors.note: A lower-right entrance zone is visible; a second ground-level glazed/door-like opening cannot be separated reliably.

materialBands: mixed dark glazing and patterned/tiled entrance treatment at ground level
records.occlusion: Balconies cut across the central bay; cars cover the lower edge.

visibleWindows.note: A broad apartment frontage shows repeated horizontal window rows, but edge truncation and the recessed balcony stack make several apertures partial.

visibleDoors.note: At least one central ground entrance is visible; another dark ground opening is ambiguous.

materialBands: recessed balcony voids and metal rails
records.occlusion: Cars and bicycles cover part of the base; balcony recesses must not be converted into flat windows.

visibleWindows.note: Three full right-side windows and a partial far-right window are visible; the broad left wall is deliberately blank.

visibleDoors.note: No entrance is visible in this full crop.

records.occlusion: Diagonal cable and suspended streetlamp cross the blank wall; street sign at the base.

visibleWindows.note: Left and right facade wings contain repeated rectangular window rows; stacked balcony recesses introduce opening/door ambiguity in the centre.

visibleDoors.note: A grey service door at left and a central glazed entrance are visible; a balcony-level door should remain an observed opening unless the output clearly distinguishes it.

records.occlusion: Vehicles hide the lower edge; a signpost interrupts the base; balcony rails and recess shadows are structural, not windows.

visibleWindows.note: A small upper opening, a pair of narrow middle openings and a large arched opening are visible; lower detail is not sufficiently exposed.

visibleDoors.note: No entrance can be distinguished behind lower foliage/crop.

materialBands: dark decorative roof and cornice elements
records.occlusion: Dense vegetation hides the ground storey; the narrow source view makes inferred symmetry especially unsafe.

visibleWindows.note: Three bays across three upper rows are clear; the lower dark glazed band may add an opening but is not separable at this source resolution.

visibleDoors.note: No leaf is reliably distinguished from the lower dark/glazed band.

materialBands: pale window surrounds and arch details
dark painted or glazed ground band
records.occlusion: Low-resolution source and overhead wire; signage/ground glazing should not be interpreted as masonry openings without evidence.

visibleWindows.note: Three upper rows of three bays are visible, plus a small roof/dormer opening that should not be merged into the regular facade grid.

visibleDoors.note: Ground-level entrance is not visible in the source crop.

materialBands: dark ground-level sign or fascia band
records.occlusion: Low contrast, overhead wires and bottom signage; preserve the asymmetrical roof/dormer treatment.

visibleWindows.note: Three broad bays repeat over the main facade; lower-left detail is obscured by a vehicle and the rightmost base includes a door-like opening.

visibleDoors.note: One narrow lower-right entrance is visible.

materialBands: pale stone/painted lintels and sill accents
records.occlusion: Vehicle masks part of the base and the left neighboring facade intrudes; do not invent a symmetric lower row.
